metadata.title: How to make Chicken stock? Back to basics episode 1
metadata.description:
Welcome to Episode 1 of my ‘Back to Basics’ series! 🎉 Today, I’m showing you how to create one of the most important building blocks in the kitchen—chicken stock🍗 

Whether you’re making soups, stews, or sauces, a good stock adds depth and richness to your dishes. All you need are a few simple ingredients like chicken, carrots, onions, garlic, and herbs, and you’re on your way to making that liquid gold! ✨ 

In this episode, I’ll also show you how to remove the scum for a clearer stock and filter it using muslin cloth for that silky smooth finish. 🥣

Want the full step-by-step breakdown? Head over to my YouTube channel for the detailed video! 📽️ Link in bio.

#backtobasic #chickenstock #homecooking #cookingfromscratch #learntocook #simplerecipe #cookingtips #kitchenhack #northeastflavor #stockmagic 

—
